title: JUDGE ANYTHING: MLLM AS A JUDGE ACROSS ANY MODALITY

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing MLLM judgments against human annotations across 15 any-to-any modality combinations in Score Evaluation and Pair Comparison settings to identify systematic misalignments and deviations in how models evaluate different modalities.
Conducting experiments with switched response positions in the Pair Comparison setting to observe and mitigate the model's tendency to disproportionately favor the first or second candidate response.
